name: Kettlebell Swing
common_faults: squatting the swing instead of hinging
arm-pulling at the top (should be hip-powered)
contraindications: acute low-back injury during ballistic loading
resistance_profile: ballistic; highest acceleration demand at the bottom of the hinge into the float phase

provenance.notes: Ballistic hip-extension exercise. Posterior-chain conditioning with cardiovascular demand at higher rep ranges. Technique-sensitive; coaching the hinge vs squat pattern is critical. SFR heuristic.
